label: Essentials
description: Core admin toolkit — kick/ban, team ops, map/vote control, sounds, and shared settings other plugins read (qlx_commandPrefix).

commands.name: id
commands.description: Sends the player list to the caller.

commands.name: disconnects
commands.description: Sends the list of most recent player disconnects.

commands.name: commands
commands.description: Sends the list of the most recently used commands.

commands.name: shuffle
commands.description: Forces a team shuffle instantly.

commands.name: pause
commands.description: Pauses the game.

commands.name: unpause
commands.description: Unpauses the game.

commands.name: slap
commands.description: Slaps a player with optional damage.

commands.name: slay
commands.description: Kills the specified player instantly.

commands.name: sounds
commands.description: Toggles custom sounds for the calling player.

commands.name: sound
commands.description: Plays a sound for players who have sounds enabled.

commands.name: music
commands.description: Plays music for players who have sounds and music enabled.

commands.name: stopsound
commands.description: Stops all currently playing sounds.

commands.name: stopmusic
commands.description: Stops any currently playing music.

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Kicks a player, optionally with a reason.

commands.name: kickban
commands.description: Kicks a player and blocks them from rejoining for the remainder of the map.

commands.name: yes
commands.description: Passes the currently active vote.

commands.name: no
commands.description: Vetoes the currently active vote.

commands.name: random
commands.description: Shows a random number in chat.

commands.name: cointoss
commands.description: Tosses a coin, returns HEADS or TAILS.

commands.name: switch
commands.description: Switches the teams of the two players specified.

commands.name: red
commands.description: Moves the specified player to the red team.

commands.name: blue
commands.description: Moves the specified player to the blue team.

commands.name: spectate
commands.description: Moves the specified player to spectator.

commands.name: free
commands.description: Moves the specified player to the free-for-all team.

commands.name: addmod
commands.description: Gives a player classic moderator status.

commands.name: addadmin
commands.description: Gives a player classic administrator status.

commands.name: demote
commands.description: Removes classic administrator/moderator status from a player.

commands.name: mute
commands.description: Mutes the specified player for the current session.

commands.name: unmute
commands.description: Unmutes the specified player.

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Locks the specified team (or all) from joining.

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: Unlocks the specified team (or all).

commands.name: allready
commands.description: Forces all players to ready up.

commands.name: abort
commands.description: Forces a game in progress back to warm-up.

commands.name: map
commands.description: Changes the map, optionally with a specific factory.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Shows minqlxtended version information.

commands.name: seen
commands.description: Responds with the last time a player was seen on the server.

commands.name: firstseen
commands.description: Responds with the first time a player was seen on the server.

commands.name: time
commands.description: Responds with the current time.

commands.name: teamsize
commands.description: Sets the teamsize restriction (0 removes it).

commands.name: rcon
commands.description: Sends a console command to the server.

commands.name: mappool
commands.description: Shows the currently enforced map pool, if any.

cvars.label: Command Prefix
cvars.description: Prefix players type before a chat command (shared across all plugins).

cvars.label: Auto-Pass Votes
cvars.description: Automatically passes votes that meet the pass threshold.

cvars.label: Vote Pass Threshold
cvars.description: Fraction of yes votes (of those who voted) needed to auto-pass a vote.

cvars.label: Enforce Map Pool
cvars.description: Restricts !map and map votes to the configured map pool file.
